description: Move up to 200 files into one folder (or the top level) in a single call. Each file succeeds or fails on its own, and the result lists every one (moved, failed, results).

files.description: Up to 200 files: slugs, UUIDs or numeric ids

items.description: The file: its slug (as in filester.me/d/<slug>), its UUID, or its numeric id

folder.description: Destination folder identifier; "root", or leaving it out, means the top level

name: move_files
title: Move files
